notes: Access: curl_cffi Chrome124 impersonation (per notes/220.md); robots.txt explicitly ALLOWs Claude bots, tier-1 HTTP fetch sufficient throughout, no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. No genuine New Arrivals PLP was found after thorough investigation; this is a correct absence result, not a failed search. Checked, all negative: (1) main header nav / mega-menu - only 9 top-level category verticals (Furniture, Furnishings, Home Decor, Kitchen & Dining, Lamps & Lighting, Luxury, Mattresses, Modular, Sofas & Seating), no New Arrivals/New In/What's New/Just In nav item; (2) footer - 'Popular Categories'/'Popular Brands' sections only, no New Arrivals link; (3) sitemap-index.xml - 11 sitemaps, all vertical-category or infrastructure (furniture/home_decor/lamps_and_lighting/mattresses/kitchen_and_dining/furnishings/sofas_and_seating/luxury/products/product.xml/stores/blogs) plus a small generic website.xml (gift cards, partner/franchisee forms, careers, design inspiration) - no bestsellers/new-arrivals/sale entries of any kind exist in the sitemap system, which also matches the negative result for the analogous New Arrivals search; (4) direct URL probing across many shapes: /new-arrivals.html, /category/new-arrivals.html, /category/new-arrival.html, /category/new-in.html, /category/whats-new.html, /category/trending-now.html, /category/new-launch.html, /category/newly-launched.html, /discover/new-arrivals.html, /discover/new-arrival.html, /discover/new-in.html, /discover/whats-new.html, /discover/latest-arrivals.html, /discover/latest-products.html, /discover/just-arrived.html, /discover/newly-added.html, /discover/new-collection.html, /discover/new-season.html, /discover/recently-added.html - every single one 404'd; (5) banner-tile cross-check on furniture.html, home-decor.html, lamps-and-lighting.html, kitchen-and-dining.html, sofas-and-seating.html, mattresses.html, luxury-brand.html, furnishings.html, and the sub-category pages dining-tables.html/beds.html - none of the many /discover/* promotional tiles found on these pages (e.g. Trending-Upholstered-Beds, Hand-Picked-Curated-Sofas, Cloud-White, Water-resistance-sofas, Bone-Inlay, Solid-Wood-Furniture, per-material dining-table/bed variant tiles, etc.) name or represent a 'newly added to catalogue' concept - they are all attribute/material/style-curated collections (e.g. by wood type, feature, or aesthetic), not recency-based; (6) cross-links inside the two confirmed live merchandising pages (/discover/best-sellers.html, /discover/clearance-sale.html) themselves - neither links to a New Arrivals page. Website's own search endpoint (/site_product/search) was intentionally NOT queried directly since robots.txt carries a blanket 'Disallow: /site_product/search' for all user-agents (including the Claude-specific allowances elsewhere in the same file, which do not override this specific path); relied on nav+sitemap+banner-crawl instead, which the brief treats as sufficient absence proof. No sale/promotional page found anywhere on the site used New Arrivals vocabulary (New In, Just Arrived, Latest, What's New, Recently Added) even loosely.
